sources.title: vLLM Semantic Router's d3 in 15 GB and d3-flash in 4.9 GB - turintech.ai
sources.snippet: The second file, d3-27B-Artemis-12.3GB.gguf, is 12.26 GB and needs 14.1 GiB for text, so it should fit a 16 GB GPU. It agrees with the original on 95.7% of the test decisions, with accuracy 0.30 points lower, and changed no confident answer.
